g.text: CE: paired dense / arm gap ratios, every registered arm
Full-32 paired medians, not ratios of group medians. Both-stable and failure-inclusive versions coincide here.
CSV retains 95% bootstrap intervals, both-failed exclusions and empty-draw counts. Colors saturate outside [0.1, 10].
